I answered Hollis in a thread on his #central-team message. Pree posted in that channel on 14 October that Tansley Parcel's signed order form is due 25 August. Hollis is in the channel, and that date isn't a money figure, so I could share it with him.

The date is still unclear. She didn't give a year, and 25 August 2026 has already passed. I asked her in her thread whether she meant next year or whether the date had moved, and she hasn't replied. So I told Hollis to check with her before putting it in the account sheet.
